subject.title: fix(matrix): deliver reasoning blocks as m.notice when /reasoning on [AI-assisted]

question: After this PR is rebased to use `reasoningPayloadsEnabled`, should live Matrix/Element proof still be required before merge, or is the in-memory Matrix adapter proof enough for this external PR?
rationale: The code defect is source-reproducible, but repository proof policy expects real behavior proof for external PRs and the submitted evidence does not show a real Matrix room send-read.

options.title: Require live Matrix proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Matrix/Element send-read output, logs, or a short recording before merge.

options.title: Accept source-path proof
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly waive live transport proof after the branch uses the existing gate and the patch review is clean.

recommendation.title: Require live Matrix proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Matrix/Element send-read output, logs, or a short recording before merge.
